meta.jurisdiction: Kingdom of Spain (Castilla y Leon, Segovia)
governing_statutes: Convenio Colectivo Provincial de Hosteleria de Segovia (BOCyL)

management.funding_status: FUNDED - sources & uses close and cash stays positive
management.notes: The requested EUR 367,535 facility is 35% of the all-in asset cost, but the binding DSCR constraint caps debt at EUR 339,144.92 (32.3% LTV) at 1.25x CFADS. The senior facility as requested breaches the covenant in Year 2 (1.15x). The land is contributed in kind and the cash equity line is the plug that closes the structure. The VAT bridge is repaid with the AEAT refund in Month 18; the LEADER grant is a post-close inflow (Month 14) that cannot fund close-day uses.

market.funding_status: FUNDED BUT BELOW 1.00x DSCR - sponsor support required
market.notes: The requested EUR 367,535 facility is 35% of the all-in asset cost, but Year 1 CFADS is negative at the official INE 21.24% occupancy, so no amount of debt can satisfy a 1.25x DSCR. The cash equity plug also absorbs a EUR 35,374.83 operating buffer. The land is contributed in kind and the VAT bridge is repaid with the AEAT refund in Month 18; the LEADER grant is a post-close inflow (Month 14).

promoter.funding_status: LIQUIDITY GAP - cash turns negative during the projection
promoter.notes: The promoter case is a re-modelling, not a replication: 86,275 is its own revenue construct and 11,297 is the deck literal, on the original financing structure: EUR 507,500 of senior debt (70% LTV) at 4.5% over 25 years, no grace period, no LEADER grant and land purchased rather than contributed in kind. It is not a replication of the source workbooks (README section 2). The EUR 99,750 input VAT exceeds the EUR 20,000 line, so the close-day structure shows a EUR 20,000 gap and Year 1 cash turns negative.

phase2_gate.recommendation: DO NOT PROCEED - Phase II requires additional funding or a smaller scope

capex_total.name: Total Phase I CapEx (realistic budget)
capex_total.formula: Land 250k + 550 m2 @ 1,000 EUR/m2 + kitchen 55k + FF&E 65k + biopool 40k + digital 12k + fees 42.6k + contingency 35.5k

management_revenue_y1.name: Management-case Year-1 revenue
management_revenue_y1.formula: 31.36% mature occupancy (ramped to 28.2% in Y1) * 8 keys * ADR + one meal per guest at EUR 25

management_ebitda_y1.name: Management-case Year-1 EBITDA
management_ebitda_y1.formula: Revenue - variable stack - payroll (60,075) - fixed opex (30,500)

management_dscr_min.name: Management-case minimum DSCR (Years 1-5)
management_dscr_min.formula: (EBITDA - FF&E reserve - tax) / senior debt service

management_cash_equity.name: Cash equity required at close
management_cash_equity.formula: Total uses - senior debt - VAT bridge - land in kind

management_total_equity.name: Total equity at close (cash + land in kind)

market_ebitda_y1.name: INE market-case Year-1 EBITDA
market_ebitda_y1.formula: Revenue - variable stack - payroll - fixed opex

promoter_revenue_y1.name: Promoter-case Year-1 revenue (re-modelled)
promoter_revenue_y1.formula: 491 room-nights * EUR 85 + 72 house-nights * EUR 380 + 859 covers * EUR 20

management_occupancy.name: Management-case mature occupancy
management_occupancy.formula: Day-weighted average of the management monthly series

market_occupancy.name: INE Segovia market occupancy
market_occupancy.formula: Day-weighted average of the INE monthly series

covenant_breakeven_occupancy.name: Mature occupancy required for a 1.25x covenant
covenant_breakeven_occupancy.formula: Bisection on the occupancy multiplier until min DSCR = 1.25x

covenant_breakeven_adr.name: ADR required for a 1.25x covenant at base occupancy
covenant_breakeven_adr.formula: Bisection on the ADR multiplier until min DSCR = 1.25x

equity_irr_10pct_adr.name: ADR required for a 10% equity IRR (8.5% exit)
equity_irr_10pct_adr.formula: Bisection on the ADR multiplier until the equity IRR reaches 10%

phase2_funding_gap.name: Phase II funding gap
phase2_funding_gap.formula: Phase I cash at end of Year 2 - Phase II cash need

project_irr_exit.name: Project IRR with 8.5% exit (management case)
project_irr_exit.formula: Unlevered FCF + terminal value at an 8.5% cap rate

terminal_value.name: Terminal value at an 8.5% cap rate

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Assets must equal liabilities plus equity across all three cases.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Verify that the VAT pass-through, the FF&E reserve and the in-kind land are booked on both sides.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Lodging and restaurant revenue must be taxed at 10%, not 21%.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Recalibrate output VAT to Ley 37/1992 art. 91.Uno.2.2o.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: CapEx input VAT recognised as a fiscal asset
guardrail_audit_rules.description: 21% input VAT on non-land CapEx must be booked as a receivable, not expensed.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Book the Modelo 303/390 deductible VAT asset and disclose the bridge facility.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Payroll hourly compliance (SMI 2026 and Segovia convenio)
guardrail_audit_rules.description: Each part-time role's gross hourly cost must be at least the SMI and the convenio reference.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: If the contracts are full-time, the annual salaries are below the convenio. Document the part-time hours.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: The management case must meet the 1.25x bank covenant in every projection year.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Year 2 breaches the covenant when amortisation starts. Extend the grace period, reduce the facility or inject equity before the first amortising payment.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Minimum cash balance over the projection
guardrail_audit_rules.description: Cash must remain non-negative after the equity plug and the DSRA.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Increase the equity injection or the revolving facility.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: DSRA sizing vs. six months of maximum debt service
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The DSRA must cover at least six months of the maximum annual senior debt service.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Pledge the DSRA in escrow before financial close.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Close-day sources must cover close-day uses.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Add equity or a larger VAT/working-capital facility.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: VAT bridge within its stated limit
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The gross input VAT drawn on the bridge must not exceed the 175,000 facility.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Size the bridge on the gross input VAT (168,021) or request a larger facility.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Management occupancy vs. INE market benchmark
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The management case should not exceed 1.10x the official INE market occupancy without justification.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Present the 31.36% case as an upside case and lead with the 21.24% market case.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: Phase II may proceed only if Phase I cash covers the full Phase II cash need.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Do not double-count the LEADER grant and VAT refund. Raise the shortfall or phase the expansion.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Project IRR with exit vs. 8% WACC
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The management-case project IRR with an 8.5% exit cap rate must exceed the 8% WACC.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: The all-in cost (1.05m) is not recovered by the exit value (terminal EBITDA / 8.5%). Revisit ADR, occupancy or the renovation scope.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Promoter case: declared calibration, not source reconciliation
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The promoter case is a re-modelling. The source workbooks contain four different Year-1 revenues (99,487.50 from the Plan de Negocio formulas; 74,851 net in Conclusiones!B5; 96,628 in Presentacion!Tablas para PPT!B11; and the 90,570 gross behind the net figure). The model's 86,275 is its own revenue construct (491 x 85 + 72 x 380 + 859 x 20) and its 11,297 is the deck literal, so there is no single source figure to reconcile. The rule is therefore NOT APPLICABLE to source verification and only reports the model target beside the source cells.
guardrail_audit_rules.condition_expression: N/A - the source has no single Year-1 revenue
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Do not describe the promoter case as a replication. README section 2 reconciles the four source figures and the EUR 20 vs EUR 25 restaurant ticket.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: The independent INE market case must also meet the 1.25x covenant.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: At 21.24% occupancy the project does not cover debt service. Re-size the debt or add equity.

guardrail_audit_rules.rule_name: Cash equity requirement vs. the 30% assumption
guardrail_audit_rules.description: The cash equity needed to close the structure must not exceed 30% of total CapEx.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: The original 30% equity assumption is not financeable at 35% LTV: the structure needs ~50% cash equity plus the land in kind.

guardrail_audit_rules.description: A 3% FF&E reserve must be deducted from EBITDA before debt service.
guardrail_audit_rules.remediation_guidance: Book the reserve as restricted cash and deduct it from CFADS.
